297: // finalizeHeredoc takes the runes read as the heredoc text and the marker,
298: // and processes the text to strip leading whitespace, returning the final
299: // value without the leading whitespace.
300: func (l *lexer) finalizeHeredoc(val []rune, marker string) ([]rune, error) {
301: 	working := append([]rune(nil), val...)
302: 	contentLines, closingLine := collectHeredocLines(working)
303: 
304: 	markerLen := len(marker)
305: 	paddingToStrip := closingLine
306: 	closingLen := len(closingLine)
307: 	if closingLen >= markerLen {
308: 		paddingToStrip = closingLine[:closingLen-markerLen]
309: 	}
310: 
311: 	padLen := len(paddingToStrip)
312: 	heredocStartLine := l.line
313: 	nContent := len(contentLines)
314: 	if nContent == 0 {
315: 		return []rune{}, nil
316: 	}
317: 
318: 	var out string
319: 	for lineNum, lineText := range contentLines {
320: 		// find an exact match for the padding
321: 		lineLen := len(lineText)
322: 		index := -1
323: 
324: 		if padLen == 0 {
325: 			index = 0
326: 		} else if lineLen < padLen {
327: 			index = strings.Index(lineText, paddingToStrip)
328: 		} else {
329: 			samePrefix := true
330: 			for i := 0; i < padLen && samePrefix; i++ {
331: 				samePrefix = lineText[i] == paddingToStrip[i]
332: 			}
333: 			if samePrefix {
334: 				index = 0
335: 			} else {
336: 				index = strings.Index(lineText, paddingToStrip)
337: 			}
338: 		}
339: 
340: 		if index != 0 {
341: 			lineNo := heredocStartLine + lineNum + 1
342: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("mismatched leading whitespace in heredoc <<%s on line #%d [%s], expected whitespace [%s] to match the closing marker", marker, lineNo, lineText, paddingToStrip)
343: 		}
344: 
345: 		rest := lineText[padLen:]
346: 		strippedLen := len(rest)
347: 		if strippedLen == 0 {
348: 			out += "\n"
349: 			continue
350: 		}
351: 
352: 		var cleaned strings.Builder
353: 		cleaned.Grow(len(rest))
354: 		atContentStart := true
355: 		for _, ch := range rest {
356: 			if ch == '\r' {
357: 				continue
358: 			}
359: 			if atContentStart && unicode.IsSpace(ch) {
360: 				cleaned.WriteRune(ch)
361: 				continue
362: 			}
363: 			atContentStart = false
364: 			cleaned.WriteRune(ch)
365: 		}
366: 		copied := cleaned.String()
367: 		out += copied + "\n"
368: 	}
369: 
370: 	finalText := out
371: 	if len(finalText) > 0 && finalText[len(finalText)-1] == '\n' {
372: 		finalText = finalText[:len(finalText)-1]
373: 	}
374: 
375: 	return []rune(finalText), nil
376: }
